parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 70 bpm with normal axis, narrow QRS, normal PR interval, normal R-wave progression and upright T waves, and no ST elevation or reciprocal change in any lead, so STEMI criteria are not met on this tracing (it may predate the infarct evolving, so serial ECGs and troponin are still needed if symptoms suggest ACS).
